lines.text: So it's three weeks since the knee replacement. How are you getting on?
I'm moving a bit better since last time and can manage the stairs one at a time now.
Let's measure the bend. You're at 95 degrees of bend and just 5 short of straight.
Sorry to barge in, there's a delivery driver at the front asking for you, I'll tell him ten minutes.
Thanks, Maureen. Right, where were we.
For the pain you're going to take paracetamol 1 gram four times a day, and the codeine 30 milligrams only at night if you need it.
Is it alright to drive yet?
Not until you're six weeks out and can stamp on a brake hard, check with your insurer too.
